taste.name: The tool is the hero
taste.trigger: When choosing what fills the first viewport of a transport brand
taste.decision: Chose a working journey form (Start, End, Now/Arrive/Leave, GO) at y=318px over a hero photo or tagline-only banner
taste.reason: Because a person who came to get somewhere wants to type, not read about the app first
evidence: planner panel 940px wide, #417193, radius 20px, inside the first 900px
two 50px inputs radius 8px with a swap control
time-mode toggle shown as three bare words, not a dropdown

taste.name: Bold carries the hierarchy, one family carries everything
taste.trigger: When building a loud voice without a second display font
taste.decision: Chose one rounded sans in two weights (700/400) over a display/body pairing
taste.reason: Because heavy weight at large size is enough to shout, and one family keeps a dense app UI coherent

taste.name: Flat tiles with a hairline, no drop shadow
taste.trigger: When stacking six content blocks of different kinds
taste.decision: Chose flat filled tiles (#F6F6F6, green, slate) at 20px radius with a 0.5px navy-tinted ring over floating shadowed cards
taste.reason: Because a fill change plus a hairline separates blocks without suggesting they can be lifted or dragged

taste.name: Utility-speed feedback
taste.trigger: When adding hover and press states
taste.decision: Chose 100ms colour changes and 150-200ms transforms with a fast-out curve over 300ms+ fades
taste.reason: Because a transit user taps in a hurry; feedback must land before the finger lifts
evidence: no reduced-motion query (a gap, not a choice to copy)
